desc:
Cart help chat to reduce drop off places a helper inside your cart that answers the small doubts shoppers have before paying. Ecom Swift LLC builds it from your own shipping, returns and product information, and tests it all the way to payment.

## Why shoppers leave the cart with unanswered questions

A shopper who reaches the cart has already chosen a product. What stops them is usually small: how long will delivery take, can I return this, is shipping free, will it fit? There is nobody to ask, so the easiest choice is to close the tab and think about it later. Later often never comes.

Cart help chat to reduce drop off works by answering that doubt in the moment it appears. The shopper stays on the page, gets a short clear reply and carries on to checkout.

## What is a cart helper?

A cart helper is a small chat feature on the cart page that answers questions about shipping, returns, sizing, discount codes and delivery times. It uses the information you already publish, so its replies match your policies exactly.

It is not a pop up that shouts at people. It sits quietly until someone needs it, gives short answers and links to your full policy pages when more detail helps. It never blocks the checkout button.

## How cart answers affect completed orders

The mechanism is removing friction at the last step. Every unanswered question is a reason to hesitate, and hesitation at the cart is the most expensive kind because the shopper was close to paying. A quick, accurate answer replaces uncertainty with confidence.

Cart aware answers go further. If the helper knows what is in the basket, it can say how far the shopper is from free shipping or what delivery looks like for their country. The questions shoppers ask also tell you where your pages are unclear, which lets you fix the cause instead of only the symptom. Results still depend on price, product and trust.

## What a good cart helper includes

- Answers to the questions your customers ask most, written in your voice.
- Clear shipping and returns wording that matches your policy pages.
- Links to the full policy for anyone who wants detail.
- Awareness of what is in the cart, where the package allows it.
- A free shipping hint that shows the remaining amount.
- Delivery estimates by country.
- A layout that works on a phone with one hand.
- A handoff to a person when the question is beyond the helper.
- A short exit question asking what stopped the shopper.
- Help for discount code problems.

## What we do

We collect your shipping rates, returns rules, size information and the questions your support inbox sees most. We turn those into short answers and set rules for what the helper must never do, such as promising a discount or discussing payment details.

Then we place the helper in your cart, match its look to your store and test it on a phone and a desktop, ending with a full checkout. Basic gives you the common questions with policy links. Standard makes answers aware of the cart and adds delivery hints. Premium adds a handoff to a person, an exit survey and a weekly summary of the questions shoppers asked.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Keep each answer to a few short sentences.
- Point to the policy page for the full terms.
- Update answers whenever your shipping or returns rules change.
- Let the shopper reach a person for anything unusual.
- Read the question summary and fix unclear pages.

**Avoid:**
- Letting the helper invent offers or promise delivery dates you cannot meet.
- Covering the checkout button or the order total.
- Writing long replies that push the cart off the screen.
- Collecting card or payment details in the chat.
- Leaving old shipping information in the answers after a rule changes.

## Who this is for

This fits a store with a steady flow of visitors who add to cart and do not finish. It suits sellers who ship internationally and see many delivery and duty questions. It also suits a small team that cannot answer every message quickly and wants common questions handled while they sleep.

## What we need from you

Send your shipping and returns policies, your most common customer questions and any size or care information that applies. Tell us which topics should go straight to a person.

We work in your own store and never need your password. Access is given as a collaborator or staff user, and you can remove it at any time. We send a short checklist after you order and a handover note once the helper is live.
